a: $65K/yr for up to 3 years (stipend, allowance, tuition), with an option of up to 4 more years of postdoctoral funding
dt: Due Oct 27, 2026, 11:59pm ET; student and adviser apply as a pair

n: HHMI Gilliam Fellowships for Advanced Study (2027)
